[b][size=6]Installation [color=#f4cccc]Guide[/color][/size][/b]

How to load Blue & Pink Tools?
[b]Android users[/b]
1. Download the file "[b][CP] [color=#c9daf8]Blue[/color] & [color=#f4cccc]Pink[/color] Tools[/b]".
2. Must download [b][color=#d9ead3]Zarchiver[/color][/b] or any types of [b]Zip[/b]/ [b]7z Extractor[/b].
3. Click Extract to get the files
4. Paste the Mod file into the Mods folder “[b][color=#fff2cc]Stardewvalley[/color][/b][b]”[/b].
5. Click your [b]SMAPI[/b] Installer and launch the app to load the CPBPT mod. Enjoy..
[b] [/b]
[b]Windows users[/b]
1. Download the file "[b][CP][/b][color=#f4cccc][b] [color=#c9daf8]Blue[/color] [/b][/color][b]&[/b][color=#f4cccc][b] [color=#f4cccc]Pink[/color] [/b][/color][b]Tools[/b]".
2. Must download [b][color=#ea9999]Winrar[/color][/b] or any types of [b]Zip [/b]/ [b]7z Extractor[/b].
3. Click Extract to get the files
4. Copy and paste the mod file into your “[b][color=#fff2cc]Stardew Valley[/color][/b][b]”[/b] folder.
5. Click your [b]SMAPI[/b] exe to load the CPBPT mod. Enjoy..

[b][i][size=4]A Little [color=#ffe599]Introduction[/color] for [color=#f4cccc]Pokegirl Gamer[/color][/size][/i][/b]
